# CLAIMs with `warrant` `interpretive`

*Warrants — How a CLAIM as stated is supported, apart from whether the record accepts it (status) and in whose voice (role). Attached to the claim, never inherited along `rests_on` or `corroborates` (ADR-043).*

**Interpretive** — supported by conceptual argument, analogy or synthesis, and settled neither way by proof or by data.

On the Black Queen Hypothesis ([THEORY-1048](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1048.md)) a cell that stops making a leaky public good saves its cost while others still supply it, so the loss is favoured to the individual and spreads. Buchnera ([THEORY-1103](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1103.md)) has lost the genes its host covers and kept those its host lacks. The Samaritan's dilemma has the same logic (Ostrom et al.), and Azam, Devarajan and O'Connell's recipient is better off in the high-aid state. The loss itself is not the pathology.
